reproduction.prerequisites: Restore measured source; configure Release/CUDA/CLI/native-tests/Hessian-AOT ON, empty GENERATIVEQC_HESSIAN_AOT_INVENTORY, real sm120 and fast-compile OFF. Verify sccache or ccache, use explicit CXX/CUDA launchers and retain cache statistics. Build generativeqc_cli, generativeqc_hessian_aot_probe, generativeqc_ks_wb97mv_hessian_probe. Export absolute BUILD_DIRECTORY, CUDA_ROOT, REFERENCE_PYTHON (PySCF/Libxc/SciPy/CuPy test environment), provider libraries and verified compiler cache on PATH. Compiler Python is build-time only. Optional GENERATIVEQC_STATIONARY_RECEIPTS retains quantitative oracles. This standalone reproduction command was not independently replayed.
